gap: No action-tool registry exists. No type requires an identity, permission scope, disclosure policy, jurisdiction/channel policy, rate limits and rollback/stop controls to be declared before a tool can be invoked.
verification: Must be written: registering a tool with any one of the six declarations missing is refused; a tripped rate limit or stop control each refuses the next call to that adapter.
notes: qip_agents::capability::CapabilitySet and qip_agents::budget::BudgetLedger (backend/crates/libs/qip-agents/src/capability.rs, budget.rs) are the closest existing pattern in the repository — a typed capability-tier declaration and a pre-work-charged budget ledger for the eighteen investment analyst agents — but they govern read/compute/production/authority tiers for analysis agents, not identity/jurisdiction/channel/rollback declarations for external action tools, and nothing in that crate is reused by anything resembling an action adapter. Audit is AGENCY-027; the architecture-wide enforcement is AGENCY-007. verify: status confirmed MISSING. Adjacent and not credited: at the edge a venue Placer already sits behind a per-venue rate limit (§29.2 quote budget, qip-edge/tests/quoting.rs) and a stop control (mass cancel on halt, GATE_MASS_CANCEL), and data sources sit behind a registration identity record; none of these is a registry that refuses registration while any of the six declarations is missing.
